title: What Makes a Good Life? Lessons from the Longest Study on Happiness | Robert Waldinger | TED
speaker: TED
zh: 【TED】美好生活是什麼？最長的幸福研究的教訓|羅伯特·瓦爾丁格 |泰德（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: What keeps us healthy and happy as we go through life?
cues.en: What keeps us healthy and happy as we go through life?
cues.zh: 當我們渡過此生 是什麼讓我們保有健康跟幸福呢？

cues.text: If you were going to invest now in your future best self,
cues.en: If you were going to invest now in your future best self,
cues.zh: 為了將來過得最好的自己， 假使你們現在正要下本錢的話，

cues.text: where would you put your time and your energy?
cues.en: where would you put your time and your energy?
cues.zh: 你會把時間和精力投注在哪兒呢？

cues.text: There was a recent survey of millennials asking them what their most important life goals were,
cues.en: There was a recent survey of millennials asking them what their most important life goals were,
cues.zh: 有個對千禧世代的近期研究 問他們人生最重要的目標是什麼？

cues.text: and over 80 percent said that a major life goal for them was to get rich.
cues.en: and over 80 percent said that a major life goal for them was to get rich.
cues.zh: 超過八成說主要的目標是變得富有；

cues.text: And another 50 percent of those same young adults
cues.en: And another 50 percent of those same young adults
cues.zh: 以及同一批未成氣候的成年人

cues.text: said that another major life goal was to become famous.
cues.en: said that another major life goal was to become famous.
cues.zh: 另有五成說另一個主要的目標 是變得名聲響亮。

cues.text: And we're constantly told to lean in to work, to push harder
cues.en: And we're constantly told to lean in to work, to push harder
cues.zh: 而且我們不斷地聽人講要傾心工作、 更賣力些以及取得更多的成就；

cues.text: and achieve more.
cues.en: and achieve more.
cues.zh: 更賣力些以及取得更多的成就；

cues.text: We're given the impression that these are the things that we need to go after
cues.en: We're given the impression that these are the things that we need to go after
cues.zh: 我們被灌輸概念－為了有美好的生活，

cues.text: in order to have a good life.
cues.en: in order to have a good life.
cues.zh: 我們被灌輸概念－為了有美好的生活， 這些東西是我們需要追求的。

cues.text: Pictures of entire lives, of the choices that people make and how those choices work out for them,
cues.en: Pictures of entire lives, of the choices that people make and how those choices work out for them,
cues.zh: 周齊的人生圖景－ 大家做出的選擇以及這些選擇 為他們帶來什麼結果－

cues.text: those pictures are almost impossible to get.
cues.en: those pictures are almost impossible to get.
cues.zh: 幾乎無從得知；

cues.text: Most of what we know about human life we know from asking people to remember the past,
cues.en: Most of what we know about human life we know from asking people to remember the past,
cues.zh: 我們對人生所知道的絕大部份 來自於訴請別人記起過往。

cues.text: and as we know, hindsight is anything but 20/20.
cues.en: and as we know, hindsight is anything but 20/20.
cues.zh: 來自於訴請別人記起過往。 如同我們所知－事後很容易有後見知明， 但是要預測未來是很難的；

cues.text: We forget vast amounts of what happens to us in life,
cues.en: We forget vast amounts of what happens to us in life,
cues.zh: 我們記不住一生當中 大多數發生在我們身上的事情，

cues.text: and sometimes memory is downright creative.
cues.en: and sometimes memory is downright creative.
cues.zh: 而且有時候記憶是極其不切實際的。

cues.text: But what if we could watch entire lives
cues.en: But what if we could watch entire lives
cues.zh: 不過要是我們能夠看見齊全的人生－

cues.text: as they unfold through time?
cues.en: as they unfold through time?
cues.zh: 當它們穿越時間展開來呢？

cues.text: What if we could study people from the time that they were teenagers
cues.en: What if we could study people from the time that they were teenagers
cues.zh: 要是我們能夠研究大家 －從他們少年一路直到老朽－

cues.text: all the way into old age to see what really keeps people happy and healthy?
cues.en: all the way into old age to see what really keeps people happy and healthy?
cues.zh: 要是我們能夠研究大家 －從他們少年一路直到老朽－ 來看是什麼確實讓人保持幸福和健康呢？

cues.text: We did that.
cues.en: We did that.
cues.zh: 我們做過了！

cues.text: The Harvard Study of Adult Development may be the longest study of adult life that's ever been done.
cues.en: The Harvard Study of Adult Development may be the longest study of adult life that's ever been done.
cues.zh: 哈佛大學的成年人生涯進展研究 或許是前所未見最長久的 成年人生涯研究，

cues.text: For 75 years, we've tracked the lives of 724 men,
cues.en: For 75 years, we've tracked the lives of 724 men,
cues.zh: 75 年來我們已經追查了 724 位男士的生活，

cues.text: year after year, asking about their work, their home lives, their health,
cues.en: year after year, asking about their work, their home lives, their health,
cues.zh: 年復一年問及其工作、居家生活、健康，

cues.text: and of course asking all along the way without knowing how their life stories
cues.en: and of course asking all along the way without knowing how their life stories
cues.zh: 年復一年問及其工作、居家生活、健康， 當然了這一路問下來 對他們人生的故事即將如何 翻轉我們也毫不知情。

cues.text: were going to turn out.
cues.en: were going to turn out.
cues.zh: 對他們人生的故事即將如何 翻轉我們也毫不知情。

cues.text: Studies like this are exceedingly rare.
cues.en: Studies like this are exceedingly rare.
cues.zh: 像這樣的研究計畫微乎其微，

cues.text: Almost all projects of this kind fall apart within a decade
cues.en: Almost all projects of this kind fall apart within a decade
cues.zh: 像這樣的研究計畫微乎其微， 幾乎所有這種研究在十年內就破局了；

cues.text: because too many people drop out of the study, or funding for the research dries up,
cues.en: because too many people drop out of the study, or funding for the research dries up,
cues.zh: 因為太多人放棄了研究， 或者金援研究的資金沒了著落，

cues.text: or the researchers get distracted, or they die, and nobody moves the ball further down the field.
cues.en: or the researchers get distracted, or they die, and nobody moves the ball further down the field.
cues.zh: 或是研究負責人琵琶別抱， 或是研究負責人死亡 而且無人讓該計畫再做出進展。

cues.text: But through a combination of luck and the persistence of several generations of researchers,
cues.en: But through a combination of luck and the persistence of several generations of researchers,
cues.zh: 不過透過好運加上幾個世代 研究人員的堅毅，

cues.text: this study has survived.
cues.en: this study has survived.
cues.zh: 這個研究並未中斷。

cues.text: About 60 of our original 724 men are still alive,
cues.en: About 60 of our original 724 men are still alive,
cues.zh: 我們原先的 724 位男士大約有 60 人 仍然還活著、一直參與著這個研究，

cues.text: still participating in the study, most of them in their 90s.
cues.en: still participating in the study, most of them in their 90s.
cues.zh: 仍然還活著、一直參與著這個研究， 他們大多都 90 多歲了，

cues.text: And we are now beginning to study the more than 2,000 children of these men.
cues.en: And we are now beginning to study the more than 2,000 children of these men.
cues.zh: 而且我們現在正要開始研究 這些男士 2,000 多名的子女們；

cues.text: And I'm the fourth director of the study.
cues.en: And I'm the fourth director of the study.
cues.zh: 而我是本研究的第四位主持人了。

cues.text: Since 1938, we've tracked the lives of two groups of men.
cues.en: Since 1938, we've tracked the lives of two groups of men.
cues.zh: 從 1938 年來我們已經追蹤了 兩組男士的生活，

cues.text: The first group started in the study when they were sophomores at Harvard College.
cues.en: The first group started in the study when they were sophomores at Harvard College.
cues.zh: 第一組當他們在哈佛大學二年級時 就開始在這個研究裡；

cues.text: They all finished college during World War II, and then most went off to serve in the war.
cues.en: They all finished college during World War II, and then most went off to serve in the war.
cues.zh: 二次世界大戰期間他們全部唸完大學， 之後大多數都離家效力於戰場上。

cues.text: And the second group that we've followed was a group of boys from Boston's poorest neighborhoods,
cues.en: And the second group that we've followed was a group of boys from Boston's poorest neighborhoods,
cues.zh: 第二組我們密切關注的－ 是一群來自波士頓最窮澀 裡坊的男孩子們，

cues.text: boys who were chosen for the study specifically because they were from some of the most troubled
cues.en: boys who were chosen for the study specifically because they were from some of the most troubled
cues.zh: 是一群來自波士頓最窮澀 裡坊的男孩子們， 被這研究選到的男孩子們 特別是因為他們來自三零年代 波士頓一些最困頓和弱勢的家庭－

cues.text: and disadvantaged families in the Boston of the 1930s.
cues.en: and disadvantaged families in the Boston of the 1930s.
cues.zh: 波士頓一些最困頓和弱勢的家庭－

cues.text: Most lived in tenements, many without hot and cold running water.
cues.en: Most lived in tenements, many without hot and cold running water.
cues.zh: 波士頓一些最困頓和弱勢的家庭－ 大多數住在低品質的公寓大樓， 很多人家還都沒有自來水和熱水。

cues.text: When they entered the study, all of these teenagers were interviewed.
cues.en: When they entered the study, all of these teenagers were interviewed.
cues.zh: 當他們進入這個研究時 這些十來歲的孩子全都有 接受採訪、做健康檢查、

cues.text: They were given medical exams.
cues.en: They were given medical exams.
cues.zh: 這些十來歲的孩子全都有 接受採訪、做健康檢查、

cues.text: We went to their homes and we interviewed their parents.
cues.en: We went to their homes and we interviewed their parents.
cues.zh: 這些十來歲的孩子全都有 接受採訪、做健康檢查、 我們去到他們家採訪其雙親。

cues.text: And then these teenagers grew up into adults who entered all walks of life.
cues.en: And then these teenagers grew up into adults who entered all walks of life.
cues.zh: 然後這些青少年長大成人 進入社會各階層，

cues.text: They became factory workers and lawyers and bricklayers and doctors,
cues.en: They became factory workers and lawyers and bricklayers and doctors,
cues.zh: 他們成了工廠工人、律師、 泥水匠、醫師，

cues.text: one President of the United States.
cues.en: one President of the United States.
cues.zh: 以及一位美國總統。

cues.text: Some developed alcoholism. A few developed schizophrenia.
cues.en: Some developed alcoholism. A few developed schizophrenia.
cues.zh: 有的人染上酒癮、 偶有人罹患精神分裂症、

cues.text: Some climbed the social ladder from the bottom all the way to the very top,
cues.en: Some climbed the social ladder from the bottom all the way to the very top,
cues.zh: 有一些從社會底層 攀越社會梯階一路飛黃騰達、

cues.text: and some made that journey in the opposite direction.
cues.en: and some made that journey in the opposite direction.
cues.zh: 有一些從社會底層 攀越社會梯階一路飛黃騰達、 有些人則背道而馳了。

cues.text: The founders of this study would never in their wildest dreams
cues.en: The founders of this study would never in their wildest dreams
cues.zh: 這個研究的發起人們絕對意想不到 －即便最狂縱的夢想中－

cues.text: have imagined that I would be standing here today, 75 years later,
cues.en: have imagined that I would be standing here today, 75 years later,
cues.zh: －即便最狂縱的夢想中－ 75 年後的今天我會站在這裡，

cues.text: telling you that the study still continues.
cues.en: telling you that the study still continues.
cues.zh: 正在告訴你們這個研究仍然未中斷。

cues.text: Every two years, our patient and dedicated research staff
cues.en: Every two years, our patient and dedicated research staff
cues.zh: 每兩年我們有耐性 跟認真賣力的研究人手

cues.text: calls up our men and asks them if we can send them yet one more set of questions about their lives.
cues.en: calls up our men and asks them if we can send them yet one more set of questions about their lives.
cues.zh: 每兩年我們有耐性 跟認真賣力的研究人手 致電給我們的研究物件， 問說我們是否能再寄送給他們 一份有關他們生活的問卷。

cues.text: Many of the inner city Boston men ask us,
cues.en: Many of the inner city Boston men ask us,
cues.zh: 許多波士頓化外之地的受訪者問我們：

cues.text: "Why do you keep wanting to study me? My life just isn't that interesting."
cues.en: "Why do you keep wanting to study me? My life just isn't that interesting."
cues.zh: 許多波士頓化外之地的受訪者問我們： 「為什麼你一直想研究我？ 我的人生一點就是不精采呀！」；

cues.text: The Harvard men never ask that question.
cues.en: The Harvard men never ask that question.
cues.zh: 哈佛大學的受訪者們從未問過該問題。

cues.text: To get the clearest picture of these lives, we don't just send them questionnaires.
cues.en: To get the clearest picture of these lives, we don't just send them questionnaires.
cues.zh: 為了取得這些人生最清楚的寫照， 我們不只是寄送給他們問券；

cues.text: We interview them in their living rooms.
cues.en: We interview them in their living rooms.
cues.zh: 我們在他們家的客廳做訪談、

cues.text: We get their medical records from their doctors.
cues.en: We get their medical records from their doctors.
cues.zh: 從他們的醫生那裡取得病歷、

cues.text: We draw their blood, we scan their brains, we talk to their children.
cues.en: We draw their blood, we scan their brains, we talk to their children.
cues.zh: 跟他們抽血和做腦部掃描、 跟他們的子女聊、

cues.text: We videotape them talking with their wives about their deepest concerns.
cues.en: We videotape them talking with their wives about their deepest concerns.
cues.zh: 拍攝下他們跟老婆談論最憂心的事情。

cues.text: And when, about a decade ago, we finally asked the wives
cues.en: And when, about a decade ago, we finally asked the wives
cues.zh: 拍攝下他們跟老婆談論最憂心的事情。 然後大約在 10 年前 到頭來我們問了他們的老婆：

cues.text: if they would join us as members of the study, many of the women said, "You know, it's about time."
cues.en: if they would join us as members of the study, many of the women said, "You know, it's about time."
cues.zh: 「妳們是否會參與我們 作為研究受訪者成員呢？」； 許多婦女說：「也該是時候了啦！」

cues.text: So what have we learned?
cues.en: So what have we learned?
cues.zh: 所以我們學到什麼了呢？

cues.text: What are the lessons that come from the tens of thousands of pages
cues.en: What are the lessons that come from the tens of thousands of pages
cues.zh: 從數萬頁的資料－我們已經從 這些人生中收集到－

cues.text: of information that we've generated on these lives?
cues.en: of information that we've generated on these lives?
cues.zh: 從數萬頁的資料－我們已經從 這些人生中收集到－ 裡面有何前車之鑑呢？

cues.text: Well, the lessons aren't about wealth or fame or working harder and harder.
cues.en: Well, the lessons aren't about wealth or fame or working harder and harder.
cues.zh: 此前車之鑑與財富、名氣、 賣命工作無關，

cues.text: The clearest message that we get from this 75-year study is this:
cues.en: The clearest message that we get from this 75-year study is this:
cues.zh: 我們從這個 75 年的研究裡得到 最明確的訊息是這個： 「良好的關係在其期間內 讓我們保持更幸福、健康！」。

cues.text: Good relationships keep us happier and healthier. Period.
cues.en: Good relationships keep us happier and healthier. Period.
cues.zh: 「良好的關係在其期間內 讓我們保持更幸福、健康！」。

cues.text: We've learned three big lessons about relationships.
cues.en: We've learned three big lessons about relationships.
cues.zh: 我們已經學到關於關係的 三大前車之鑑： 第一個是人際聯絡確實對我們是好的，

cues.text: The first is that social connections are really good for us,
cues.en: The first is that social connections are really good for us,
cues.zh: 第一個是人際聯絡確實對我們是好的，

cues.text: and that loneliness kills.
cues.en: and that loneliness kills.
cues.zh: 而孤獨是要命的。

cues.text: It turns out that people who are more socially connected
cues.en: It turns out that people who are more socially connected
cues.zh: 最終發現與家庭、朋友、社群

cues.text: to family, to friends, to community, are happier, they're physically healthier, and they live longer
cues.en: to family, to friends, to community, are happier, they're physically healthier, and they live longer
cues.zh: 較有人際聯絡的人是較為幸福、 身體比較健康的， 而且比起聯絡沒那麼好的人活得較長久。

cues.text: than people who are less well connected.
cues.en: than people who are less well connected.
cues.zh: 而且比起聯絡沒那麼好的人活得較長久。

cues.text: And the experience of loneliness turns out to be toxic.
cues.en: And the experience of loneliness turns out to be toxic.
cues.zh: 孤獨的經歷結果發現到是非常折磨人的， 比起自己所設想與外人更無牽扯的人

cues.text: People who are more isolated than they want to be from others
cues.en: People who are more isolated than they want to be from others
cues.zh: 比起自己所設想與外人更無牽扯的人

cues.text: find that they are less happy, their health declines earlier in midlife,
cues.en: find that they are less happy, their health declines earlier in midlife,
cues.zh: 察覺到他們比較不幸福， 他們在中年時健康較早下滑、

cues.text: their brain functioning declines sooner and they live shorter lives than people who are not lonely.
cues.en: their brain functioning declines sooner and they live shorter lives than people who are not lonely.
cues.zh: 腦功能下滑更快， 比起不孤獨的人他們比較短命。

cues.text: And the sad fact is that at any given time, more than one in five Americans will report that they're lonely.
cues.en: And the sad fact is that at any given time, more than one in five Americans will report that they're lonely.
cues.zh: 令人遺憾的事實是在任何時間點 多過 1/5 的美國人會白紙黑字 說他們是孤單的！

cues.text: And we know that you can be lonely in a crowd and you can be lonely in a marriage,
cues.en: And we know that you can be lonely in a crowd and you can be lonely in a marriage,
cues.zh: 我們知道你們有可能在人群裡、 一段婚姻中是孤單的，

cues.text: so the second big lesson that we learned is that it's not just the number of friends you have,
cues.en: so the second big lesson that we learned is that it's not just the number of friends you have,
cues.zh: 所以第二個我們學到的前車之鑑則是： 不只是你擁有的朋友人數、

cues.text: and it's not whether or not you're in a committed relationship,
cues.en: and it's not whether or not you're in a committed relationship,
cues.zh: 不只是你擁有的朋友人數、 無關你到底是否正投入 在一段感情之中，

cues.text: but it's the quality of your close relationships that matters.
cues.en: but it's the quality of your close relationships that matters.
cues.zh: 你的品質才重要。

cues.text: It turns out that living in the midst of conflict is really bad for our health.
cues.en: It turns out that living in the midst of conflict is really bad for our health.
cues.zh: 結果發現到生活在相爭不讓下 對我們的健康實在是不好，

cues.text: High-conflict marriages, for example, without much affection, turn out to be very bad for our health, perhaps worse than getting divorced.
cues.en: High-conflict marriages, for example, without much affection, turn out to be very bad for our health, perhaps worse than getting divorced.
cues.zh: 例如沒有太多的情愛、時常爭吵的婚姻 結果發現對我們的健康是非常不好的， 或許比起離婚還要更糟糕。

cues.text: And living in the midst of good, warm relationships is protective.
cues.en: And living in the midst of good, warm relationships is protective.
cues.zh: 而生活在良好、溫暖的 關係之中是受到保護的。

cues.text: Once we had followed our men all the way into their 80s, we wanted to look back at them at midlife
cues.en: Once we had followed our men all the way into their 80s, we wanted to look back at them at midlife
cues.zh: 自從我們密切關注完我們的受訪 男士們一路直到他們 80 多歲， 我們想要回過頭來看中年時的他們，

cues.text: and to see if we could predict who was going to grow into a happy, healthy octogenarian
